correctness.rationale: The exact inclusion-exclusion coefficient formula is proved for each S subset of ten edges. The two executable independent finite methods compute all 1024 Walsh coefficients, and agree on all 21 signed levels, on exactly 150 zeros in 34 orbit classes, and Parseval 1024*388. The exact transform of the 874-mode support has absolute kernel sum 7924, giving the projection norm 1981/256. Counting all edge subsets for n=3,4,6 gives odd cardinalities 7,41,5789 and hence no zero Walsh coefficients; this is finite exhaustive, not a general-n assertion.
